The world's first dual handlebar throttle control system is easy and intuitive. Pull the right lever to go forward and the left lever for reverse. WET SUMP LUBRICATION
Uses two engine oil pumps to deliver lubricated oil to each moving part with water-jacketed sump and oil backflow protection.
RIDE YOUR WAY

Ride the way you want. Pop your handlebar up and stay standing in rough waters, head for the middle ground for an ultra-comfortable cruising experience or go low when you're ready to race. Your screen is also adjustable, so you can change the performance and appearance to be a perfect match for whatever adventure you're on.
LUXURY COMFORT FOOTWELL AND EASIER RE-BOARDING

From four-step, tilt-adjustable steering to a luxury three-person cruiser seat, and from practical handlebar tie points to a large swim platform with a deeper, wider, softer, more comfortable step and dual handles for re-boarding. description.text: Yamaha 4-cylinder 4-stroke 1.9 Liter High Output Yamaha Marine Engine 1898 cc
RiDE - 4.3” Connext Screen with Security and Drive Control Audio System by Yamaha Touchpad Control Cruise Assist / No Wake Mode Performance Auto Trim Multi-Mount System Capable

RIDE (REVERSE WITH INTIUTIVE DECELERATION ELECTRONICS)

The world's first dual handlebar throttle control system is easy and intuitive. Pull the right lever to go forward and the left lever for reverse. Pull them both or in any combination and the system reacts with precise control. Benefits include better handling smooth deceleration and more control while turning.
WET SUMP LUBRICATION
Uses two engine oil pumps to deliver lubricated oil to each moving part with water-jacketed sump and oil backflow protection.
THROTTLE BY WIRE REVERSE SYSTEM
Controls RPM in reverse gear for maximum thrust efficiency. Specially Designed, One-piece Cylinder and Crankcase Assembly
ELECTRONIC FUEL INJECTION

Advanced multi-point fuel injection system utilizing a single electronically controlled throttle body and multiple reliable sensors working in armory for optimum air/fuel mixture under any condition. The result is a smooth high-power output with low fuel consumption and low exhaust emissions.
SPECIFICALLY DESIGNED, ONE-PIECE CYLINDER & CRANK CASE ASSEMBLY
Provides tremendous engine rigidity that's lighter and stiffer than two-piece designs.
SLANT DETECTION SWITCH
Electronic switch stops engine and oil pumps immediately if watercraft becomes overturned protecting motor from unwanted water ingestion.
SWAS (SCAVANGER ASSIST PUMP)
Equipped with a high-performance, compact gas-liquid separator, this engine uses Yamaha's unique ultra compact lubrication system and the oil pan structure.
ENGINE MAINTENANCE SYSTEM

An integrated computerized management system that controls and adjusts such functions as ignition timing fuel injection mapping engine diagnostics and OTS. The OTS function of Y.E.M.S. activates when the operator releases the throttle lever and attempts to steer the watercraft. This assists the operator in turning while the watercraft is decelerating.
THERMOSTAT AND PRESSURE CONTROLLED COOLING SYSTEM
Water flow through the engine is controlled by a thermostat and pressure system and is maintained by a pressure control valve.
CORROSION PROTECTION SYSTEM
Sacrificial zinc anodes protect the engine from harmful galvanic corrosion. Stainless steel fasteners (nuts, bolts, hardware) provide a long service life.
4.3 INCH CONNEX HELM CONTROL

The GP Series now features modern dash instrumentation including Yamaha’s 4.3-inch Connext Helm Control with a multi-colour LCD display. A touchpad control mounted next to the steering column provides convenient access to the Connext system’s many functions.
ALL NEW YAMAHA AUDIO SPEAKERS

Engineered to withstand the rigorous conditions of marine environments, these premium speakers offer exceptional durability and deliver superior sound quality, even at high speeds and through splashing waves.
